execution.p4_source_status: No P4 source difference from main baseline 573f5a6 at the time of this probe.

cases.name: unchanged-image-rom-boot
cases.result: Second-stage bootloader reached; app not reached; remains at early RNG entropy initialization.

cases.result: Actual PC/register match the official bootloader entropy wait; ADC is not mounted in the current P4 device set.

execution.privacy: Only public firmware metadata and aggregate execution/PC/MMIO facts retained. Raw logs and third-party binaries remain local.

source_inferred_later_gaps.condition: PHY_LOCK bit 0, then two-lane stop status bits 2/4/7
source_inferred_later_gaps.status: No DSI behavior mounted; native probe did not reach this call.
Missing command packets, FIFO states, bridge scanout, format/enable gates and completion behavior.
Missing linked-list walk, memory-to-DSI handshake, markers, IRQ and rearm; AXI/AHB GDMA and DMA2D are different transports.
Existing shared implementation can inform P4 M2M support, but needs register compatibility verification, P4 mounting, memory adapter, clock/reset and interrupt integration.
Hardware I2C0 is not mounted; touch/reset/IRQ and expander power controls need real devices. Existing P4 BoardModel bus 0 means hardware I2C1 and must remain compatible.

not_claimed: DSI behavior based on a constant ready flag or direct frontend framebuffer painting
Camera/ISP, audio, sensor or C6 networking support
